title: Entity change history
responsibility: Builds ancestor-only history and reads exact-revision source measurements independently of verification records.

inputs.name: historyDetail.detail
inputs.description: Stored revision used to derive this unit's source measurements, presence, change, version, explanations, and verdict. Source measurements come only from the active registry unit without workload or profile qualifiers, and known status requires both an available registry and stored source impact.

inputs.name: historyDetail.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier matched against active registry entries, explanations, source measurements, and the revision's change evidence. A non-active or absent registry entry does not produce a version or verdict.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.index
inputs.description: Harness history index supplying revision summaries and per-unit growth and reviews. Revisions are limited to the selected commit's ancestry, and growth points and reviews are matched by commit.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.scope
inputs.description: Resolved explorer scope whose commit anchors the ancestry walk. Only that commit and its ancestors can contribute rows; later revisions are excluded.

inputs.name: explorerHistory.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier matched against each revision's added, removed, or direct change lists and against indexed growth and reviews. A recorded unchanged revision is omitted, while a revision without change data is represented as a gap.

outputs.name: explorerHistory
outputs.description: Newest-first rows for the selected commit and its ancestors when the history records a direct, added, or removed change, or lacks change data. Each row keeps its first parent, measurement at that commit, the size and complexity delta from the preceding measured ancestor, and reviews recorded at that commit; known unchanged revisions are omitted.

outputs.name: historyDetail
outputs.description: Exact-revision details for the requested unit: active source measurements, whether registry and source-impact evidence are known, presence, change, version, matching explanations, optional non-empty regressions, and a verdict only when the unit is active. Source measurements exclude workload and profile measurements, and absent values are null.
